prompt: As of August 1, 2024, which country were holders of the FIFA World Cup the last time the UEFA Champions League was won by a club from London?
answer: France. Chelsea, from London, last won the UEFA Champions League in 2021; at that time, France were the reigning FIFA World Cup holders after winning in 2018.
